args:
set -euo pipefail
test "${PTD_COST_AUTHORIZED}" = "true"
test -n "${PTD_CODE_BUNDLE_URI}"
test -n "${PTD_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT_PREFIX}"
if gsutil ls "${PTD_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT_PREFIX}/**" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "refusing non-empty output prefix" >&2; exit 20; fi
mkdir -p /workspace/source /workspace/results
gsutil cp "${PTD_CODE_BUNDLE_URI}" /workspace/ptd-code.tar.gz
echo "${PTD_CODE_BUNDLE_SHA256}  /workspace/ptd-code.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /workspace/ptd-code.tar.gz -C /workspace/source
cd /workspace/source/research/ptd-sigir-2027
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python scripts/check_citations.py
python scripts/validate_artifacts.py
python scripts/run_trainer_smoke.py --output /workspace/results/trainer_smoke.json
python scripts/run_alternating_solver_smoke.py --output /workspace/results/alternating_solver_smoke.json
python scripts/run_retrieval_runner_smoke.py --output /workspace/results/retrieval_runner_smoke.json
python scripts/run_evaluation_emitter_smoke.py --output /workspace/results/evaluation_emitter_smoke.json
printf '%s\n' "${PTD_CODE_BUNDLE_SHA256}" > /workspace/results/code_bundle_sha256.txt
printf '%s\n' "preflight-only:no-ptd-result" > /workspace/results/SCOPE
gsutil -m cp -n /workspace/results/* "${PTD_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT_PREFIX}/"
printf '%s\n' "complete" > /workspace/PREFLIGHT_SUCCESS
gsutil cp -n /workspace/PREFLIGHT_SUCCESS "${PTD_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT_PREFIX}/_SUCCESS"
